summary.text: Joe Sweeney is a Republican member of the New Hampshire House of Representatives from Rockingham 25 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election after advancing from the September 8 primary.

paragraphs.text: Joe Sweeney lives in Salem, New Hampshire, and graduated from Salem High School in 2012.
He earned a bachelor's degree in political science in 2016 and a master's degree in public policy in 2018, both from the University of New Hampshire.
Sweeney has served as the vice chair of the Salem, New Hampshire Charter Commission and has been affiliated with the Salem Rotary Club and the Salem Exchange Club.
Sweeney represented Rockingham 8 in the New Hampshire House of Representatives from 2012 to 2016, and Ballotpedia lists his current tenure as beginning in 2020.
